messages:
maria: heads-up — deploying model-routing v2 in ~10m. want to use feature flag `routing_v2_enable` with a latency-aware ramp (quantile slicing) instead of pure % cohorts.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy by @maria at 2026-03-21 15:10 UTC. runbook: /runbooks/route-v2-deploy (please review).

ben: +1 on quantile slicing. last time a straight % ramp pushed slow-tail traffic and p99 spiked.

jen: proposed plan (suggested by perf team):
- Phase 0 (canary): quantile 0-5 (fastest 5% requests by edge latency) -> ~0.5% of traffic
- Phase 1: quantile 0-20 -> ~2%
- Phase 2: quantile 0-50 -> ~10%
- Phase 3: open to 100% after soak & checks

tess: quick note on quantiles: we tag requests with a latency-decile header `X-rt-quantile` via kstream preprocessor (edge.latency_ms rolling window). that lets us route by quantile without global sampling bias.

sre-oncall: hard abort thresholds we want in place before canary: 
- p99 latency delta > +250ms vs baseline sustained for 5m -> immediate rollback
- error-rate absolute increase > 0.5% -> rollback
- request queue length > 2000 -> fallback/isolate
(also: alert paging to #eng-oncall + PD)

ben: what's the fast-disable command? give me an exact string i can run from my laptop.

maria: fast disable we use in runbook: 
```
# disable flag globally
rbctl ff set routing_v2_enable false --note "latency-safety"
# rollback route service to previous tag if needed
rbctl deploy rollback route-service --to-tag route-v1
```
Or via ops-bot: `/ops ff disable routing_v2_enable` (will annotate the release).

ops-bot: tip: /ops ff toggle routing_v2_enable off --reason "latency-safety" will also attach an audit event.

jen: telemetry queries to confirm health (examples):
- baseline p99: `p99(edge_latency_ms{service="route-service"}[15m])`
- compare window: `p99(edge_latency_ms{service="route-service"}[5m]) - p99(edge_latency_ms{service="route-service"]}[24h:1m])` (simplified)
- error-rate: `sum(rate(route_errors_total[5m])) / sum(rate(route_requests_total[5m]))`

maria: schedule: start canary at 15:10 UTC -> wait 10m for stability, then escalate phases with 20m soak each. rollout order: us-west -> us-east -> eu (regional dependence).

sre-oncall: add automatic circuit-breaker rule: if route-service CPU > 85% for 3m OR queue depth > 2000 -> auto-fallback to route-v1 and disable flag. we should wire this into the deploy pipeline.

ben: ack. i'll monitor dashboards (redwood.console/dashboards/route-v2) and be on pager duty for first 45m. ping me direct if alerts fire.

tess: also: pin model binary/version in flag to avoid any auto-upgrades during rollout. command: 
```
rbctl ff set routing_v2_version "v2.3.1" --sticky --note "pin for canary"
```

maria: decision: proceed with the plan above. release notes blurb i'll post in #eng-releases 5m before start: "route-v2: latency-aware quantile roll, pinned v2.3.1, rollback conditions set".

jen: +1. i'll run canary and stay oncall for first 30m.

deploy-bot: Deploy started by @maria at 4870009999
deploy-bot: Canary cohort enabled -> `routing_v2_enable=true` (quantile 0-5) ~= 0.5% traffic

ops-bot: reaction :rocket: (👍 x3)

sre-oncall: temporary alerts added for release: RouteV2_P99_Regression, RouteV2_Error_Rate_Surge. targets: #eng-oncall, #eng-releases.

ben: if anything weird i want immediate pings. otherwise i'll post a short status at each phase boundary. ttyl.
